premise: a bright casual puzzle and party game of saga maps, bundles and round results

slots.name: cartoon/panel
slots.note: A cartoon panel: a fully opaque warm cream (#fff4dc) slab with softly rounded corners (about 18 px at this size), a thick 4 px dark chocolate-brown (#3a2210) cartoon outline all round, a lighter inner rim just inside the outline and a chunky darker shadow lip along its bottom edge, the centre flat cream so dark text reads on it; as the cream board of the concept's settings, without its title ribbon. Plain corners: no leaves, flowers, vines or corner ornaments anywhere; the thick outline and the rim are its only decoration. Its top, bottom, left and right edges are plain and even along their whole length (they stretch): any ornament sits in the four corners, none at the middle of an edge.

slots.name: cartoon/card
slots.note: A shop or bundle card: a fully opaque light cream (#fffaf0) rounded rectangle (about 14 px corners), a thick 4 px dark chocolate-brown (#3a2210) cartoon outline, a soft darker band along its bottom edge. No ornament, star or sparkle anywhere: it is repeated many times; only its outline and shading. Its top, bottom, left and right edges are plain and even along their whole length (they stretch): any ornament sits in the four corners, none at the middle of an edge.

slots.name: cartoon/field
slots.note: A dropdown or text field: a fully opaque pale beige (#f6e6c4) rounded rectangle (about 10 px corners) with a 3 px warm brown outline and a soft inner shadow along its top; the centre plain, as the Speakers dropdown of the concept. No ornament, star or sparkle anywhere: it is repeated many times; only its outline and shading. Its top, bottom, left and right edges are plain and even along their whole length (they stretch): any ornament sits in the four corners, none at the middle of an edge.

slots.name: cartoon/slot
slots.note: An inventory socket: a fully opaque recessed tan (#ecd6a8) rounded square (about 10 px corners) with a 3 px brown outline and a narrow inner shadow (a few px) just inside its top and left rim; the whole centre one even flat tan, with no blotch, gradient or vignette. No ornament, star or sparkle anywhere: it is repeated many times; only its outline and shading. Its top, bottom, left and right edges are plain and even along their whole length (they stretch): any ornament sits in the four corners, none at the middle of an edge.

slots.name: cartoon/tooltip
slots.note: A small tooltip: a fully opaque dark chocolate-brown (#3a2210) rounded rectangle (about 10 px corners) with a 2 px lighter brown rim; the centre plain so cream text reads on it. No ornament, star or sparkle anywhere: it is repeated many times; only its outline and shading. Its top, bottom, left and right edges are plain and even along their whole length (they stretch): any ornament sits in the four corners, none at the middle of an edge.

slots.name: cartoon/hud
slots.note: A glossy currency pill for a cartoon HUD: a fully rounded pill of cream with a thick 4 px dark chocolate-brown (#3a2210) cartoon outline, a white gloss highlight along its upper half and a darker band at its bottom, as the coin and gem counters of the concept's map screen; the centre plain. No ornament, star or sparkle anywhere: it is repeated many times; only its outline and shading. Its top, bottom, left and right edges are plain and even along their whole length (they stretch): any ornament sits in the four corners, none at the middle of an edge.

slots.name: cartoon/button
slots.note: A secondary cartoon button: a fully rounded-corner (about 12 px) chunky button of pale tan (#f3dfb4) with a thick 4 px dark chocolate-brown (#3a2210) cartoon outline, a white gloss highlight along its upper third and a thick darker 5 px lip along its bottom that makes it look pressable; the centre flat so dark brown text reads on it. No ornament, star or sparkle anywhere: it is repeated many times; only its outline and shading. Its top, bottom, left and right edges are plain and even along their whole length (they stretch): any ornament sits in the four corners, none at the middle of an edge.

slots.name: cartoon/button-primary
slots.note: The primary cartoon button: a chunky rounded (about 12 px corners) button of bright warm orange (#ffab5c at its top to #f2862f lower down) with a thick 4 px dark chocolate-brown (#3a2210) cartoon outline, a glossy white highlight streak along its upper third and a thick darker orange (#c8601c) 5 px lip along its bottom; the label area across the middle flat light orange (#f7983f) so a bold dark chocolate-brown label reads on it at 7:1; as the Done button of the concept, lighter. No ornament, star or sparkle anywhere. Its top, bottom, left and right edges are plain and even along their whole length (they stretch): any ornament sits in the four corners, none at the middle of an edge.

slots.name: cartoon/divider
slots.note: A cartoon divider: a short row of three chunky round dots in warm orange with dark brown outlines, the middle one larger, on a clear background.

slots.name: cartoon/flourish
slots.note: A small title flourish: one chunky four-point sparkle star in yellow (#ffcc33) with a dark brown outline, on a clear background.

slots.name: cartoon/thumb
slots.note: A slider's thumb: one round chunky white knob, perfectly circular, with a thick 4 px dark chocolate-brown (#3a2210) cartoon outline, a small gloss highlight at its upper left and a soft grey band at its bottom; as the white knobs on the concept's volume sliders. Nothing else: no track.

slots.name: cartoon/knob
slots.note: A switch's knob when it is on: one round chunky white knob, perfectly circular, with a 3 px dark brown outline and a small gloss highlight; as the knob of the concept's Subtitles switch. Nothing else: no track.

slots.name: cartoon/knob-off
slots.note: A switch's knob when it is off: one round chunky light grey (#e6e2da) knob, perfectly circular, with a 3 px dark brown outline so it reads at 3:1 against a mid grey track, and a small gloss highlight; as the knob of the concept's Mute everything switch. Nothing else: no track.
